additional_info.subject: RE: ID0481635-DC/Si-D/FR- [MPR4 170001746] Shutdown Revenue Leakage CRM:03288000406
additional_info.body:
Hi,
Thank you for the analysis, but the issue is still not resolved.
Right after the blackout, the
meterStop
sent for transaction
ID 498
is equal to the
meterStart
value.
However, the EV SOC increased from
50% to 55%
, which means that energy was indeed delivered.
Due to the blackout, the charger sent an incorrect
meterStop
value when communication was restored.
As a result, the billing amount is
€0
.
For reference:
07:12:30 → meterStart = 74,478,815
11:46:07 → meterStop = 74,478,815
There appears to be a bug or software issue when a blackout occurs during a charging session.
Please continue the investigation and apply a fix.
Cordialement,

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0481635-DC/Si-D/FR- [MPR4 170001746] Shutdown Revenue Leakage CRM:03288000406
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Nicolas, dear RC-FR colleagues,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support team to provide you with support in regards of ticket
ID0481635.
I reviewed your analysis provided in the ticket, and I confirm that it is correct: unfortunately, due to the event of grid outage, the charger did not bill the power transferred for transactionID: 72595445.
I can tell you that our R&D department has already identified similar situations where a StopTransaction with reason "PowerLoss", the charger sends the meterStop value equal to the meterStart value. This edge case has been already addressed by our R&D department. I will escalate this case to them as well, but I can confirm to you that it will be addressed within the next FW release
v9.0,
which is expected to be released in
CW15
(beginning of April 2026).
Our regional colleagues form France will inform you once the FW will be available to be installed.
If you have further questions, please feel free to reach out in this ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
